Variants.Content: House Sanglas is a coastal vassal around Dragonstone, with its lands connected to small harbors, fishing grounds, and shipping routes to Blackwater Bay. The family has long been on the border between the old Targaryen fiefdoms and the crown coast, paying homage to Dragonstone's royal traditions while also dealing with the taxes, fish, salt, and storms of a common port town. The strength of Sanglas is not in the large area of ​​​​fields, but in the familiarity with tides, shoals, coastal beacons and news of incoming ships; if a small port can see enemy sails in time, it may be more valuable than a larger hall inland.

The Dragonstone nobles view Sanglas as a small family on the coast that must remain sane. They do not often have the power to determine the throne, but they can influence the smooth arrival of ships, supplies, and news.

The people of Sangras know their families from fish schools, salt bags, tides and beacon fires. To them, Dragonstone's ancient lineage is far away, and whether the ship can avoid the reef is very close. If the lord understands the sea, the family crest will have meaning; if not, the port will remember the missing people for them.
Entry Sunglass Entry Sunglass The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Sunglass Entry Sunglass Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.

Entry Sunglass Entry Sunglass The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Sunglass Entry Sunglass They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
